_comment: Hosted bundles of the game's 3D models (docs/ASSETS.md). fetch_assets.py downloads and unzips each into assets/. Rebuilt 2026-10-07 from Tripo batch 1, plus the Megalodon boss.

species_fbx.contents: species/<SpeciesId>.fbx: Nibbler, Cuda, Puffer, MorayEel, ReefShark, Angler (rigged: Root/Head/Spine1..N/Tail)
species_fbx.clean: No normal maps (stripped 2026-10-14: strip_normals.py for GLBs, fbx_strip_normals.py byte-level for FBX); screened with the classifier (exit 0).

prey_glb.contents: prey/<PreyId>.glb: Minnow, Sardine, Wrasse, Snapper, Grouper, Barracuda, ReefShark (static, squared up, facing -Z)
prey_glb.clean: No normal maps (stripped 2026-10-14: strip_normals.py for GLBs, fbx_strip_normals.py byte-level for FBX); screened with the classifier (exit 0). Colour maps moved out of skin tones by safe_colors.py: Barracuda, Grouper, Minnow.

props_glb.contents: props/<Name>.glb: GiantKelp, KelpClump, BoulderRound, BoulderJagged, BrainCoral, FanCoral, StaghornCoral, TubeSponge, Anemone, Shrimp, Starfish, Shell, Lantern, CrystalCluster, MarketStall
props_glb.clean: No normal maps (stripped 2026-10-14: strip_normals.py for GLBs, fbx_strip_normals.py byte-level for FBX); screened with the classifier (exit 0). Colour maps moved out of skin tones by safe_colors.py: BrainCoral, Lantern, MarketStall, Shell, StaghornCoral.

boss_fbx.contents: bosses/Megalodon.fbx (7 spine segments), bosses/GiantSquid.fbx (6; the arms trail and wave); rigged like species, import to FishModels.<Id>
boss_fbx.clean: No normal maps (stripped 2026-10-14: strip_normals.py for GLBs, fbx_strip_normals.py byte-level for FBX); screened with the classifier (exit 0).

prey_fbx.contents: prey/<PreyId>.fbx: Minnow, Sardine, Wrasse, Snapper, Grouper (rigged, 4 spine segments; replaces the static prey_glb set, which still works)
prey_fbx.clean: No normal maps (stripped 2026-10-14: strip_normals.py for GLBs, fbx_strip_normals.py byte-level for FBX); screened with the classifier (exit 0). Colour maps moved out of skin tones by safe_colors.py: Grouper, Minnow.

props2_glb.contents: props/TreasureChest.glb (the dig site's chest, half out of the sand)
props2_glb.clean: No normal maps (stripped 2026-10-14: strip_normals.py for GLBs, fbx_strip_normals.py byte-level for FBX); screened with the classifier (exit 0). Colour maps moved out of skin tones by safe_colors.py: TreasureChest.

vendors_glb.contents: props/Keeper<VendorId>.glb: KeeperOutfitter (hermit crab), KeeperMason (octopus), KeeperCharms (sea turtle), KeeperDyer (pufferfish), KeeperTrophies (scarred grouper); the shopkeepers, from the approved Vendors concept. v2 of 2026-10-11 (sha256 917bf7b7...): the base colors of the Mason, Outfitter, Dyer and Charms moved out of skin tones by tools/props/safe_colors.py (salmon to vivid orange, cream to cool white, tan to greige, browns darker), and all five cleared by screen_shades.py with the classifier (highest 0.016). Front faces +X in the GLB.
vendors_glb.clean: No normal maps (stripped 2026-10-14: strip_normals.py for GLBs, fbx_strip_normals.py byte-level for FBX); screened with the classifier (exit 0).

shade_skins.contents: <Fish>_Shades.glb for Nibbler, Cuda, Puffer, MorayEel, ReefShark, Angler: one quad per skin, 27 each (its own 12-skin line from tools/shades/lines.json plus the 15 universal skins: catch track, weekly, Tide Pass season 1, boss and treasure; 162 skins, v7 of 2026-10-12: v6 plus the four Tide Pass skins PassTideglass, PassRiptide, PassUndertow, PassAbyssalCurrent on every fish; all six GLBs changed; every GLB cleared by screen_shades.py with the classifier, highest 0.176; sha256 72895dd2228a51cd...)

furniture_glb.contents: furniture/<Name>.glb: the 38 den furniture pieces of batch 1 (Config/Dens items with a `set`), each cut off its approved board (assets/concepts/Furn*.jpg) and made with Tripo image_to_model (tools/tripo_jobs_furniture_models.json). Every normal map taken out by tools/props/strip_normals.py (never upload a normal map), base colors moved out of skin tones by tools/props/safe_colors.py (the Kraken eye repainted amber first), and all 76 images (color + ORM) cleared by screen_shades.py with the classifier (highest 0.11). Front faces +X in the GLB. sha256 55f68372...
